t: This is Monzo, the British online bank based in London. It launched as one of the app-based challenger banks entering the UK market. Several people are named as its founders: Tom Blomfield, Jason Bates, Paul Rippon, Gary Dolman and Jonas Huckestein. Of them, Tom Blomfield is the best known. He's a British entrepreneur, and he is now a group partner at Y Combinator.
